method.name: extract
method.description: The document-type's own extractor, bound into its registration record rather than living in a separate module-local dispatch map keyed by docType.

rationale: sc2's stated purpose is that 'the daemon tool registry, IPC method table, and MCP tool surface enumerate one source of truth instead of three hand-maintained lists (k4)'. As published, the record carries only docType + capability + extractorInputSchema, so a fourth hand-maintained list is still required at runtime: a map from docType to the extractor that services it. That map is a second registration surface sitting beside the registry and drifting from it in exactly the way k4 exists to prevent — the design judgment scored a1, a3, and a4 all `partial` on sc2 for precisely this reason, and scored a2 `satisfies` only because it binds extract() into the record. Adding the method makes get(docType) the single resolution path from an external request to an implementation, which is also what makes ac5/k2 verifiable at one boundary crossing. The change is additive and localised: register/list/get signatures are unchanged, docType/capability/extractorInputSchema are unchanged, one of four shared contracts is touched (25%, under the rework threshold), and the four consuming stories (s2/s3/s4/s6) each register their own extractor rather than reading a foreign one, so none of them breaks. The one accepted cost is that the record stops being plain data, so capability enumeration crossing IPC/MCP must project the serializable subset (docType + capability + extractorInputSchema) before marshalling — noted here so the HLD carries it rather than each surface rediscovering it. Two further shape changes this LLD makes — sc1's derived/narrated partition and sc4's parameterization with the `shell` → `value` rename — are NOT proposed as amendments because they change shapes s2–s7 already consume; they are raised as a single back-flow note to those stories instead, per the winning judgment's instruction that one pass cover both.

citations.ref: sc2 DocTypeRegistration — purpose: 'one source of truth instead of three hand-maintained lists (k4)'

Winning alternative a2, sc2 verdict `satisfies`: 'binding extract() into DocTypeRegistration removes the second hand-maintained dispatch map that a1, a3, and a4 all carry alongside the registry — the precise drift k4 exists to eliminate'
